response.target_definition: The native numeric Taxable Value cell on one source detail row marked Domestic and G, from a reference whose detail rows share one consistent unambiguous day-first date. The task is offline estimation of this stored line-level field in unspecified source amount units.
response.unknown_category_policy: unseen one-hot categories are ignored and explicitly counted
known_limitations: Exploratory offline field estimation only; no business-approved price, revenue, profit or demand prediction.
Unresolved-date references, exports and services are excluded; the selected population is not representative of all NOP activity.
Item-code identity is scoped to one source field; unseen codes have no learned product effect.
Source amount units and physical quantity units are not independently approved; no aggregation or unit conversion is performed.
The chronological holdout is small and irregularly sampled; prospective business performance is unknown.

response.objective_name: Confirmed-date invoice references per observed month (exploratory subset)
response.target_definition: Count distinct Invoice Num references in the source workbook whose every detail row has one consistent, unambiguously day-first Invoice Date, grouped by observed calendar month.
known_limitations: This is a confirmed-date subset, not total invoice volume.
The exact invoice reference is assumed unique within this workbook only.
Unresolved dates are excluded and may create month-dependent undercounts.
No zero periods were inserted; absent months mean unknown, not zero.
No semantic approval, execution authorization, or publication receipt was created.
